facts.summary: The brass compass is beneath the northern observatory staircase.
The signal lamp burns blue whale oil.
The harbor bell rings after three white flashes.
Courier Tessa follows the slate footpath to the eastern orchard.
Mara develops a rash when she eats cinnamon.
The ferry is called Glass Finch.
The watchkeeper orders everyone out when cracks spread across the vaulted corridor.
Captain Neri tears up the warrant and lets the prisoner leave unharmed.
The patched skiff carries all six stranded passengers across the channel.
The visitor proves that he knows the guard by naming the guard's wife and their childhood village.
The medic revives the exhausted runner with cold water and a quiet place to rest.
The council postpones the vote because too few members are present to decide.
The iron safe's access code is orchid-27.
The hidden dispatch uses the recognition phrase night heron.
Rowan and Mira jointly owe six thousand silver coins to the harbor guild.
The iron safe stands beside a green ivy pot in the archive.
In the original ending, Glass Finch docks at the eastern quay.
In the original ending, harbor clerk Ana signs the bridge permit.
A porcelain compass ornament sits on the southern staircase.
The archive's decorative lamp burns amber resin.
Mira hides a bronze orchard token in her boot.
The guild buys a painted skiff that remains on dry land.
